    //Called by client, tells server to spawn a hook and give it velocity
    [ServerRpc]
    private void RequestServerThrow(Vector3 origin, Vector3 direction, Vector3 linearVelocity, string grappleId, RPCInfo info = default)
    {
        EquipmentModel equipmentModel = GetComponent<EquipmentModel>();
        int selected = equipmentModel.selectedItem.value;
        if (selected == -1) return;

        GrappleHookUse clientGrappleInstance = equipmentModel.equipmentSlots[selected].item.useBehavior as GrappleHookUse;
        if (clientGrappleInstance == null) return;
        _grappleInstance = clientGrappleInstance; //set server's copy of client's grapple instance

        Vector3 spawnPos = origin + direction * 2.5f;

        // Spawn hook projectile on server
        var hook = Instantiate(_grappleInstance.hookPrefab, spawnPos, Quaternion.LookRotation(-direction));

        hook.ServerInitialize(
            controller: this,
            grappleInstanceId: grappleId,
            origin: spawnPos,
            linearVelocity: linearVelocity,
            thrower: info.sender,
            basePlayerController: IsTopRider() ? mountController.GetBottom().grappleHookController : null
        );

        //Extra check in case previous recall didn't finish destroying hook before new one spawns
        if (currentHook != null)
        {
            Destroy(currentHook.gameObject);
            currentHook = null;
        }

        currentHook = hook;
        //Tell connected clients to visualize rope of thrower
        SetHookAttach(currentHook, this);
    }
